headline: Anthropic IPO reportedly set to price this week
source: Semafor, via The Neuron and Tech Trends News Update
pages: Anthropic is reported to be close to pricing its initial public offering. One daily brief said the pricing could come Wednesday night after the order book was heavily oversubscribed, while The Neuron said the stock debut is expected later this week. Semafor reported that the company raised its target share price even as technology stocks were weak. The exact oversubscription figure appeared in only one source, and no source has confirmed a final price. Separately, explainx.ai noted that the Center for AI Safety issued a statement questioning the company's safety branding ahead of the listing.

A public offering would make Anthropic one of the first major AI labs to trade on a public market, giving investors a direct stake in the AI boom.
